units: metres, y-up; position = centre of object's base, in parent space; rotation = degrees XYZ

interpretation.summary: Climb from the entrance deck (south-west) through the robot yard, past the laser gate, over the pillars and up the conveyor ramps to the exit on the top deck (north-east).

character.note: spawn the glb at position (yaw deg), play clips.idle looped; while a player is within trigger.radius of trigger.center crossfade (fade s) to clips.alert; bob float.node: y = amp sin(2 pi t / period)

drive.note: press_profile(): u = (t + phase) mod period; ram offset -travel (u/slam)^2, held, eased back over rise; each stage moves offset * frac; rotor angle = whole-turn cycles + spin-up / peak / coast-down from the impact; the head's glow blinks for 'warn' s before each slam; camera shake within 'shake' m on impact
drive.plasma_note: u offset = rotor angle / 360 * plasma_tiles (it turns with the arms); v offset = -t * plasma_rise - pressed * 0.5 (pressed = -ram offset / travel); opacity = plasma_energy(u) (0 until the impact, 1 while pressed, fading over spin_down); emission x (0.25 + energy (0.5 + 0.6 pressed + flicker) + 1.2 exp(-3 (u - slam)) after the impact)
drive.arcs_note: Stage 157/158: while energy > 0 the arcs layer shows with alpha max(min(1, 1.6 exp(-1.8 ds)), 0.55 energy) x crackle (ds = u - slam; k = floor(24 t): hash(k) = fract(sin(12.9898 k) * 43758.5453) > 0.35 ? 1 : 0.15), its uv jumping to (fract(0.618 k), fract(0.382 k)); else hidden. The light at 'light.pos' (low: it flashes the deck) = light.energy x 2 x min(1, 1.6 exp(-1.8 ds)) x crackle (the impact only); 'sparks' (chamber centres): effect <id>_Sparks bursts at the impact and the crackles after it

sweeper.note: angle(t) = arm + rpm * 6 * t deg (level yaw convention: direction (sin, cos)); a bar kills a body it overlaps (jump over it), a ball kills within ball_r

pod_path.note: pod centre s = s0 + fmod(t * speed, spacing) along pod_pose(path, s); bone = rest pivot moved to the pose, turned about +z by -(theta(s) - theta(s0))

floater.note: per pad: joint offset (0, amp sin(2 pi (t + phase) / period), 0), yaw +-yaw, tilt +-tilt (about the deck centre); flame_joint scale y flickers; square decks: deck_size / deck_yaw; sink (Stage 189): a player standing on a deck loads it (assembly.sink_step), at 'hold' s it shudders down (sink_profile x pad sink_depth) and rises back
per pad: joint offset (0, amp sin(2 pi (t + phase) / period), 0), yaw +-yaw, tilt +-tilt (about the deck centre); flame_joint scale y flickers

jet.note: assembly.jet_pose: home bob -> (player on trigger) fly -> wait (hatch opens; the button terminal goes live) -> press -> back home

boss_lift.note: parked at the top; the first time a player enters 'trigger' (or the game calls start_boss_lift(id)) it waits 'delay' s, flashes its lamps for 'warn' s, then descends 'travel' m (smoothstep, 'duration' s) onto the dais and stays: its top (deck_y) is a floor; anyone under it as it lands is pushed out past 'radius'; signal boss_lift_landed(id, boss_spawn) - spawn the mini boss there

lift.note: stand on it 'wait' s -> it travels (smoothstep, 'duration' s) to the other end; a player in a call zone brings it to that end when it is empty; carries whoever stands on it

saw.note: joint k turns its group and every later one about axis through its own pivot by amp_k sin(2 pi (t + phase) / period - lag_k) degrees; the spin group also turns rpm about the axis through the blade centre; kill within radius of the blade centre and 0.7 m of its plane (normal = axis)

joint k turns its group and every later one about axis through its own pivot by amp_k sin(2 pi (t + phase) / period - lag_k) degrees; the spin group also turns rpm about the axis through the blade centre; kill within radius of the blade centre and 0.7 m of its plane (normal = axis)

stops_on.note: the game calls boss_defeated() (apply_effects.gd) when the mini boss dies

belt.note: a body standing on the deck (within width / length, feet within 0.4 m of it) moves speed * axis m/s; Stage 190: the belt's travel p += speed * k * dt (k 1 -> 0 over stop_time once stopped); cleats at fmod(p, spacing) - spacing along axis; each roller turns sign * p / radius about its local y; the 'surface' material's UV v offset = fmod(-p / spacing, 1) (its tile_m = spacing * cos(pitch): one belt link per cleat)

bob.note: Stage 187: Scotch yoke - d = rc sin(w t + phi0), the cog's own turn

riser.note: the arena starts under the liquid; its platforms surge up in order when a player enters the trigger sphere - goofy: see assembly.goofy_pose

splash.note: per pad: at each tk in pad.splash a ring of slime droplets bursts from the liquid surface round its footprint (pad.size), up and out under gravity; for 'drips' s after the second, droplets fall off its rim as it climbs (fading rate); all die at the liquid

indoor.note: roofed level with a skylight dome: the real sky shows through it (full-detail panorama); sun casts no shadows

beacon_red.notes: Stage 171: the laser gate's flashing beacons

belt.notes: Stage 190: the conveyors' heavy link belt - one link per cleat spacing along the slope (tile_m = spacing * cos(pitch)); scrolled with the cleats

ce_frown_face.notes: Stage 137: the mini boss's chest face (X eyes, frown) painted on the dais - cut out

ce_signs.notes: Stage 135: CONSTRUCT ERROR_ banner, X banners, logo monitors (references/make_showcase_art.py)

cog_machined.notes: Stage 188: machined steel, counter-tinted by the inverse of the hall's pink light (sun 1 / 0.62 / 0.8) so it renders as neutral steel - the cogs' rims, hubs, ribs, bolts, crank pins (plain colour)

cog_paint.notes: Stage 181: yellow paint on the cog towers' axle caps / pipe bands (plain colour: no texture)

cog_steel.notes: Stage 184/188: dark cast iron - the cogs' webs and ribs (plain colour)

dais_plate.notes: Stage 143: the dais (boss lift) top - one lathe-turned gunmetal disc, no panel grid, mapped once (tile_m = its diameter)

deck_scraped.notes: Stage 105: the spinner deck - plain, scored by the maces' sweep (rings centred on the tower)

fall_veil.notes: Stage 139: the bright, see-through veil over each waterfall

fan_rays.notes: Stage 147: soft yellow light rays blowing out of the west wall fans (like the dome's rays)

gate_atlas.notes: Stage 171: the security laser gate's RESTRICTED AREA sign + laser warning plates (pipeline/make_gate_art.py)

gear_decal.notes: Stage 122: the grinning gear painted on the start deck - cut out, no background tile

glow_green.notes: Stage 155: green status lamps on the spinner crown

lift_ring.notes: Stage 141: the machined steel ring round the showcase dais (the boss lift's frame)

light_pool.notes: Stage 130: where the dome's light lands on the slime

monitor_back.notes: Stage 148: the jet screen's moulded back - drawn once (vents, screws, mount plate, sticker, port), no tiling

monitor_bezel.notes: Stage 148: plain plastic bezel round the jet screen

pipe_liquid.notes: Stage 142/166: glowing slime inside the glass pipes - realistic bubble trains, lens-shaded with rims and glints, over luminous swirls (scrolled by Pipe_Bubbles)

pole_stripe.notes: Stage 106: diagonal hazard stripes wound round the mace poles (concept art)

pump_glow.notes: Stage 187: the cog pumps' glow (barrel ring, gauge) - surges at the bottom of each stroke (Cog_Pump_Glow)

saw_hub.notes: Stage 132/137: saw blade hub + rings (flange, nut, the rings that glowed red) - plain near-black metal, nothing on it that shows the spin

specimen_scan.notes: Stage 168/178: the showcase monitor's dissection scan (pipeline/make_specimen_schematic.py, from her mesh) - its halves stacked (two screen panels): twice the pixels across

spinner_arcs.notes: Stage 157: bolts only - flashes and jumps about inside the chambers for ~1.6 s after each slam (sweepers[].drive.arcs)

spinner_plasma.notes: Stage 155/157: red plasma with winding lightning inside the spinner's glass chambers (dark between the bolts) - turned with the rotor and surged by the press (sweepers[].drive.plasma)

spinner_plasma_core.notes: Stage 157: the white-hot electrode down each plasma chamber (its name starts with spinner_plasma: it surges with the plasma)

splash_pool.notes: Stage 139: soft glowing churn where a waterfall lands

sunbeam_haze.notes: Stage 130: the volume of light under the dome - nested soft cones, streaked

tank_green.notes: Stage 135/152/156: the specimen vat's glowing slime glass (one layer: the glass and the liquid) - thin enough to see the specimen clearly

trim.notes: platform rims: yellow / black hazard stripes (concept art)

tube_band.notes: Stage 154: the pod tubes' bands - Toxic Works' plum trim with a red light strip (no hazard stripes)

tube_drum.notes: Stage 186 (user: less repetitive, more industrial): the transport tubes' drums - flanged bolted lips, riveted seam, louvred service panel, one small red status lamp, ID plate (wrapped once per drum)

tunnel_dark.notes: Stage 149: black veils down the tunnel - deeper is darker

tunnel_liquid_fade.notes: Stage 150/153: smooth darkening over the tunnel slime - clear at the mouth, black by the back wall, clear again behind it (no wrap bleed)

tunnel_roof_fade.notes: Stage 150: tunnel roof - same smooth fade

tunnel_wall_fade.notes: Stage 150: tunnel lining walls - lit at the mouth, smoothly to black at the back

void.notes: Stage 176: pure black that stays black under the lights (no ambient / reflections): bottomless bores, hatch openings

exits.note: walking into the black at the end of the exit hallway loads the next level (Construct Error: handle in the level_exit trigger)

entrances.note: the player appears here, walking out of the black hallway
